g.text: No old request identity or running command.
Timer expiry and spoken stop preserve it;
session reset, fall and restart clear it.
Key methods shown; parameter/return types shortened where evident.
Private controller operations run on one serialized loop.
Views share the same game, controls and agent.
CliView uses JLine Terminal/Status and its private DashboardReader.
Live CLI redraws a fixed panel; plain sessions omit periodic maps.
CliView implements Java AutoCloseable; controller closes first.
AI sees control context only: no map, position or goal.
Local SemIf is an external HTTP boundary, not a Java class.
